shared_elements: horizontal band or register line crossing the upper part of the object
paired eye forms rendered as raised ovals
justification: The clearest correspondence is superficial: both are vertically oriented, tan weathered surfaces with a horizontal dividing band across the upper zone and prominent paired oval eye forms beneath it. Otherwise they are unlike — A is a single sculpted human face in the round with painted colour, while B is a flat pillar face bearing multiple registers of low-relief animal figures, so the subject matter, technique and composition scarcely overlap.
